content: PartyKit cross-party communication: this.room.context.parties.<partyName>.get(<roomId>).fetch(...) lets one room call another party's room like an HTTP resource; not available inside onAlarm (use raw https://<project>.<user>.partykit.dev/parties/<partyName>/<roomId> fetch as workaround there). Documented worked example is a singleton 'occupancy tracker' room, exactly the directory-room pattern.
